top_categories.workout_context: At mile 60 of 126, glycogen is gone. This workout teaches your body to produce watts on fumes.

Road-specific control matters at Cheaha Challenge Gran Fondo. Practice on brutal paved mountain loops through Alabama's: use smooth gear and cadence changes, accelerate deliberately out of corners, and settle quickly back into sustainable power for 126 miles.
Race-pace efforts that mimic Cheaha Challenge Gran Fondo's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before May.
103ft/mi signals a climbing-heavy course. Sustained sub-threshold and threshold work builds the steady power needed without turning the opening climb into the day’s hardest effort.
At Cheaha Challenge Gran Fondo, changes in grade or pace can lift effort above threshold before it settles again. Over-unders train that transition while you keep riding.
13,000ft of climbing makes aerobic ceiling relevant when the grade or pace changes. VO2max work supports those hard moments; sustained climbing and conservative pacing remain the spine.
13,000ft of climbing on grades that change every minute. You need to switch from seated to standing without losing rhythm.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of Cheaha Challenge Gran Fondo. Train it until it feels boring.
Every hard session works better with a bigger aerobic base. At 126 miles, base fitness is the difference between racing and surviving.

Brief efforts above sustainable power can come from grade changes, positioning, or closing a gap at Cheaha Challenge Gran Fondo. Train them without letting those efforts derail the longer pacing plan.
126 miles rewards fat oxidation. This volume work shifts your fuel mix so you're still burning fat at hour 5, not bonking at hour 3.

Steeper ramps, positioning, or pace changes on brutal paved mountain loops through Alabama's can demand short hard efforts. Practice them without compromising the sustained work that defines the course.

race_overlay.heat: May in Jacksonville, Alabama, USA can bring heat. Complete 3–4 heat exposure sessions in the final 2 weeks before Cheaha Challenge Gran Fondo. Increase sodium intake 48 hours before race day.
race_overlay.nutrition: Target 60–80g carbs/hour for Cheaha Challenge Gran Fondo’s 126 miles. Start fueling within the first 30 minutes — early fueling prevents late-race collapse. Bonking at mile 60 is a nutrition failure, not a fitness failure.
race_overlay.altitude: Altitude may change sustainable power and recovery at Cheaha Challenge Gran Fondo. Use conservative pacing and test any travel strategy before the event.
race_overlay.terrain: The technical descents at Cheaha Challenge Gran Fondo demand practice on similar paved roads. Ride brutal paved mountain loops through alabama's high country at race-day cadence weekly. Practice braking points, corner entry, line choice, and accelerating smoothly out of turns. Confirm tire pressure and equipment before race week.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on Durability, Road Specific, and Race Simulation to prepare you for 126 miles of brutal paved mountain loops through alabama's high country in Jacksonville, Alabama, USA.
